document.title: Summary of Benefits 2027, Aetna Medicare Select Extra (HMO-POS)
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw; pages counted in the PDF, which equal the printed page numbers. The document's columns are "Your in-network costs" and "Your out-of-network costs"; the importer writes the out-of-network column's values to the POS tier (decision 4).

checks.item: Plan deductible, out of network (POS option)
Maximum out-of-pocket, in and out of network combined
checks.printed: $10,100 for in- and out-of-network services combined
checks.note: The file states the amount as the combined in-network and out-of-network maximum (pbp_d_comb_max_enr_amt "10100.00"; pbp_d_oon_max_enr_oopc_yn "2"), and the document says "combined". BPS has no combined slot, so it is in source_references only (spec 7.1). Plan Finder prints it as the out-of-network maximum.

No pbp_Section_C_POS group lists 7a, and pbp_c_pos_mc_bendesc_subcats leaves it out; the importer writes no POS row for a category no group lists (spec 5.4), so the document does not say "not covered". Question O1 (section 7).

pbp_b7d_copay_amt_mc_min "0.00", _max "38.00". Plan Finder prints the in-network specialist as $0-$38; this document prints no $0 specialist row, so which service is $0 is not shown. The importer writes the range (spec 5.5).

checks.printed: $70 copay after your plan deductible is met

checks.item: Inpatient hospital, in network, days 1 to 5
Inpatient hospital, in network, days 6 to 90
Inpatient hospital, in network, additional days
checks.printed: $0 for additional days ("Inpatient (unlimited number of days)")
checks.note: pbp_b1a_bendesc_ad_up_nmcs "010" (additional days chosen), pbp_b1a_bendesc_amo_ad "2" (Mandatory), pbp_b1a_bendesc_lim_ad "1" (unlimited), pbp_b1a_copay_ad_intrvl_num_t1 "1" (Zero intervals). With 0 intervals the file gives no day range and no amount for the additional days, so the importer writes no step; the cell is quoted in the tier notes. Writing $0 would need a start day the file does not state.
